title: CloudGoat: vulnerable Cognito
description: A CloudGoat scenario by Usama Azad, deployed into your own AWS account: a sign-up and login page backed by Amazon Cognito. Bypass the sign-up restrictions and abuse Cognito misconfigurations to elevate your privileges and obtain Cognito identity pool credentials.
question: Obtain AWS credentials from the scenario's Cognito identity pool as an admin user.
